notes.content:
"I collected bones from charnel-houses; and disturbed, with profane fingers, the tremendous secrets of the human frame." - Victor Frankenstein

Some tremendous secrets should be perhaps be left undiscovered, but now the time has come to get your profane fingers on some amazing Belladonna Trading Cards. 

The full set has 13 unique Cards, with some never-before-seen concept art, full-res versions of the portraits in the game and much more. The Cards will drop randomly as you play the game.

So leave the bones at the charnel-houses and get to collecting some Belladonna Trading Cards instead!

notes.title: It lives again!
notes.content:
"And now, once again, I bid my hideous progeny go forth and prosper" - Mary Shelley

The game Belladonna has been lying in the ground for month now. A number of brave resurrectionists and grave robbers have dared to poke at it, and have been much rewarded for their courage. Now, however, it is time to collectively breathe some new life into this painted corpse. 

Belladonna goes on sale for two weeks, with 33% off. This is a wonderful opportunity for you to take up the macabre dance and see what the long dead Belladonna have to offer.
